A. Physical Contact & Manipulation.touch: Direct physical contact between entities (e.g., hand touching another person's arm or shoulder) without grasping.
A. Physical Contact & Manipulation.hold: Physically grasping and supporting an entity with hands or arms (hands must actively grip the entity; standing near an object resting on the ground is NOT hold).
A. Physical Contact & Manipulation.carry: Supporting and transporting an entity while in motion.
A. Physical Contact & Manipulation.grab: Sudden, rapid taking hold of an entity.
A. Physical Contact & Manipulation.lift: Raising an entity upward from a lower position.

B. Spatial Separation & Security.get_off: Subject who was previously in physical possession, holding, or carrying an entity actively releases, departs from, or leaves it stationary (a passerby with no prior possession or physical contact CANNOT get_off an entity).
B. Spatial Separation & Security.lean_on: Resting body weight against an object or person for support.

C. Physical Force & Motion Transfer.push: Applying force to move an entity away from subject.
C. Physical Force & Motion Transfer.pull: Applying force to move an entity closer to subject.
C. Physical Force & Motion Transfer.throw: Propelling an object through the air by hand.
C. Physical Force & Motion Transfer.hit: Striking an entity with sudden physical force.
C. Physical Force & Motion Transfer.kick: Forcefully striking an entity with a foot.
C. Physical Force & Motion Transfer.knock: Striking a surface to produce sound or attract attention.

D. Vehicle & Animal Mobility (VEHICLE/AN.get_on: Mounting or entering a vehicle or rideable animal.
D. Vehicle & Animal Mobility (VEHICLE/AN.drive: Operating and controlling a motorized vehicle.
D. Vehicle & Animal Mobility (VEHICLE/AN.ride: Sitting on and traveling via a vehicle or animal.

E. Interpersonal & Social Interaction.shake_hand_with: Mutual hand grasping between persons in greeting.
E. Interpersonal & Social Interaction.hug: Wrapping arms tightly around another person.
E. Interpersonal & Social Interaction.wave: Moving hand back and forth as a visual signal/greeting.

F. Specialized Actions.bite: Using teeth to grip or cut an object.
F. Specialized Actions.feed: Giving food to another person or animal.
F. Specialized Actions.clean: Removing dirt, stains, or marks from an object.
F. Specialized Actions.cut: Dividing or penetrating an object using a sharp tool.
